explanation: French Guiana, on South America's north coast, is a region of France itself rather than a colony, so its border with Brazil is a French border, and an EU one.

claims.text: France shares a land border with Brazil, through French Guiana.
Portugal, Spain and the Netherlands share no land border with Brazil.
French Guiana is an overseas region of France, not a colony.
French Guiana is part of the European Union, so its border with Brazil is an external border of the EU.
